sentences.text: As per the case set up by the plaintiff, there had been certain proceedings under Sections 4 to 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
However, it is the case of the plaintiff that the possession of the property has never been taken over by the respondent.

6. It is thus stated that in Civil Writ petition 1639 of 1986 titled as Balak Ram Gupta v. Union of India and Ors., this Court had quashed the acquisition, and no compensation was offered to the earlier owner.

entities.text: Balak Ram Gupta v. Union of India and Ors

sentences.text: The plaintiff, therefore, states that she has been in uninterrupted possession since 04.01.1981.

7. The plaintiff, however, states that for some time, officials from defendant Nos.3 to 6 were roaming around the suit property, claiming it to have been acquired, despite the plaintiff showing ownership documents.
According to the plaintiff, the said officials of the defendants refused to peruse the documents presented by the plaintiff.

8. It is also stated that on 28.07.2025, officials from defendant Nos.3 to 6, accompanied by the police, were seen around the property, which has caused sufficient threat to the plaintiff for his dispossession.
Certain other averments have been made so as to indicate that even on 02.08.2025 as well, a group of 10-12 officials was seen around the property in question.
9. Under these circumstances, the petitioner has filed the instant suit.
10. The plaint be registered as a suit.
